# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old in earlier volumes  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c22 P18](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0018)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a little boy with a bare, brown heel and small pink tongue who grows two inches older over a single season. He loses a front tooth, which Mrs. Lynde removes by tying a string to it and pulling it with a door.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004)_

## Personality

Davy is a mischievous, inquisitive, and loud young boy who frequently gets into trouble through impatience and restless energy. Despite his rebellious pranks and struggle with bad habits, he is affection-seeking, honest, and openly admits his mistakes to Anne.

_Sources: [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c19 P43](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0043), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v3 c22 P22](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0022)_

## Traits

- Mischievous and squirmy  <sub>[v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c22 P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013)</sub>
- Inquisitive about nature and fairy tales  <sub>[v3 c22 P26](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0026), [v3 c22 P30](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0030)</sub>
- Honest with Anne  <sub>[v2 c19 P43](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0043), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047)</sub>

## Abilities

- Untying knots in herring nets

## Goals

- To get an Indian headdress made of colored feathers  <sub>[v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016), [v2 c22 P17](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0017)</sub>
- To marry Stella Fletcher when he grows up  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora are taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Following the death of his uncle, Richard Keith, a trust fund is created to pay for his maintenance, allowing him to stay permanently at Green Gables. Davy frequently gets into mischief around the farm and school, such as pulling feathers from the white rooster for an Indian headdress, squirming during meals, and ruining cream pies by tumbling onto a pantry table while storing string balls. He shares a fond bond with Anne Shirley, often seeking her approval, asking endless questions, and confessing his bad deeds directly to her.

_Sources: [v2 c17 P27](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0027), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c19 P43](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0043), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_
